messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: P1 - Elevated 5xx rate on dedicated-eu-1 for tenant XenonCorp. Pager: @oncall-oliver. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/dedicated-tenant-5xx. Incident ID: INC-3587654321
Oliver (oncall): Ack, taking. Investigating ingress LB and model pool. Putting fallback routing on pause.
Sanjay (eng): I'm looking at autoscaler logs, seeing pod restarts around 17:02 UTC. Sharing recent logs: `kubectl logs -n dedicated xenon-pool-3 | tail -n 200` -> OOMKilled x2
Maya (sre): Noted. Can we confirm customer impact list? I'll draft initial customer-facing line.
Kate (account): @Maya (sre) pls cc XenonCorp contacts: Alex Rivers (CTO) <alex.rivers@xenon.com>, Priya Gupta (SRE) <priya.gupta@xenon.com>, support@xenon.com. Also Keystone Labs on same shard.
Ops Oncall: Mitigation applied: scaling down model to `v2-quant`, enabling cached responses for repeat API keys. Commands run: `redwood infra scale --pool xenon-pool-3 --replicas 1` && `redwood models switch xenon-model --to v2-quant`
Sanjay (eng): Rollback not safe; failing at runtime. Trying to cordon node with noisy GPU: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7`
Maya (sre): Draft customer note for XenonCorp (short): 'We are investigating increased 5xx errors for tenant XenonCorp in EU. We have applied a temporary model fallback and additional scaling to restore service. No customer data access occurred. Expected recovery within 90 minutes. For high-impact jobs, contact your SRE priority channel.' Thoughts?
Kate (account): LGTM. Add link to status page and dedicated incident contact: ops-oncall+enterprise@redwood.com
Maya (sre): Status page proposed text: 'Degraded service for specific enterprise tenants in EU region. Engineers actively investigating; temporary mitigations applied. Next update in 30 minutes.'
Darren (cs): I'll prepare individualized email for Alex Rivers - include impact: bulk batch inference jobs failed with 5xx; interactive API shows latency spikes up to 2s and intermittent 502.
Ops Oncall: Observed: queue backlog at ingress, KV cache warming. Applied: `pkill -f stuck_worker || true` to restart stuck workers; cleared queue entries where age>2h.
incident-bot: Incident update: Mitigation in progress. Severity remains P1. Runbook step 4 in progress.
Oliver (oncall): Handoff -> @Maya (sre) you're taking next shift. Current state summary: 1) Partial mitigation: v2-quant applied; 2) Errors reduced from ~18% -> ~6% but still above SLO (1%); 3) Key actions: drain noisy node, monitor for regressions, prepare customer message. Logs retained under /var/log/incidents/INC-3587654321
Maya (sre): Taking handoff. I'll stage status page update and send tailored note to XenonCorp + Keystone Labs. ETA first customer comms 17:35 UTC.
Kate (account): I'll join the call with Alex at 17:40 UTC. Feeding in account SLAs and support contract details.
Darren (cs): :thumbsup: prepping message template.
Maya (sre): Customer-facing template (short): 'Hello Alex — We're actively addressing an incident impacting inference endpoints in EU. We've applied temporary fallbacks and expect stabilization within 90 minutes. If you have urgent jobs, we can prioritize them manually. No data exposure detected. - Redwood Inference Ops'
Oliver (oncall): Note for handoff: avoid scaling too high; autoscaler loop triggers create CPU pressure causing OOMs. Set `maxReplicas=6` for now.
Maya (sre): Acknowledged. I'll set `maxReplicas=6` and observe.
incident-bot: Final update for thread: last note at 17:40 UTC. Keep thread updated with status page link and final RCA timeline.
